name: Photo-collage with AI imagery (surreal cut-up)
look: generated or stock photos cut and recombined: heads on objects, scale jokes, colour-field backdrops.

products: where authenticity of real people matters

when_not: Avoid where authenticity of real people matters.

type.rule: Style type is for the world's chrome and display; the brand face always sets the real claim line and any product UI text.

colour.guidance: editorial serif + grotesk; one flat colour field + b/w photos.
colour.rule: Style palette fills the world; the brand colour takes the role named in brand_lock.colour_role and never drops below the contrast of the brand's own palette.

keeps: real product UI capture (composited as a screen plate, never redrawn)
brand_lock.colour_role: brand colour is the flat colour field behind black and white photos
brand_lock.type_role: editorial serif + grotesk; brand face for the claim
brand_lock.world_changes: cut-up photos with scale jokes and heads on objects
brand_lock.rule: Under a brand lock the brand colour, type and logo stay; the style world (material, picture language, motion grammar, finish, sound) is what varies between looks. A branded launch shows 3 different style worlds.

motion_grammar.note: grammars lists existing library/grammars ids; grammars_planned lists world grammars the engine plan adds (game-world, tabletop, os-desktop, type-only, editorial, collage, cinematic-world).

effects_note: rasan-fx passes (runtime/rasan-fx.js); order is the pass order. {brand_colour} / {second_ink} are filled from the brand or look palette.

codex_assets.prompt_template: isolated {subject} (portrait, hand or object) on flat background, consistent lighting, high contrast
codex_assets.r1_note: isolated subjects on flat bg (portraits, hands, objects), consistent lighting; or full surreal scenes.
codex_assets.rules: Flat, evenly lit plain background (chroma green or pure white) for clean cut-outs; one prompt family with the same seed words; generate at 2x and downscale; never ask Codex for readable UI text or logos (typeset them in HTML).

build.engine_meaning: reference only (builder hand-codes it) / gap (nothing yet)

product_ui_rule: If the film shows RasanAI Studio, use the current dark sidebar UI with the Describe...Final dot stepper (docs/brand/studio-ui/), as a real capture composited INTO this style; never the retired light UI.

palettes.name: Magazine cut
palettes.words: aged magazine paper, black, cut red, cobalt

palettes.name: Dreamy cut
palettes.words: dusty pink paper, aubergine ink, coral, sea green

brand_lock.rule: Brand colour is a flat geometric cut-out (circle, bar) added over the photo parts; paper and photo tones stay style-fixed. Slots marked brand take the brand colour (exact hex); slots marked style keep the palette value; brand-or-style takes the brand colour only when its contrast against the other slot is at least 4.5:1, else the palette value.

scale.note: cqw = 1% of the frame width (1080p: 1cqw = 19.2 px)

pairings.note: Editorial serif for titles, small grotesk for captions; mix roman and italic.

scale.note: cqw = 1% of the frame width (1080p: 1cqw = 19.2 px)

type.load: In a HyperFrames composition add the two <link> tags from `google` to <head> (plus rel=preconnect to fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com), set font-family from `css`, and wait for document.fonts.ready before the first screenshot / timeline build. Offline renders: download the families once (they are OFL) into the project's fonts/ folder and use @font-face. The brand face always sets the real claim line and the product UI text; the style pairing is for the world's chrome and display.
type.rule: Style type is for the world's chrome and display; the brand face always sets the real claim line and any product UI text. Under a brand lock keep the brand face for the claim and use the pairing's display for labels only.

finish.how: Runtime: RasanFX.create({ source, passes: [...] }) from runtime/rasan-fx.js, applied in the listed order, on the whole composition canvas or on the Codex plate only (plate-only when the type must stay crisp). `css` lists the cheap approximation kinds story boards and style frames draw with plain CSS (grain:<opacity>, scan:<opacity>, halftone, pixel, led-dots ...).

composition.grid: cut-up spread: a big photographic head, objects replacing body parts, geometric colour shapes; 5-9 layered cut-outs
composition.fill: hero cut-out 60%; shapes in the rest
composition.product_ui: UI is cut out as a printed page glued on the collage; capture stays unaltered

codex.template: {subject} {action}, {setting}. Camera and lens: flat studio scan of each cut-out; source photos shot with an 85 mm portrait lens on a neutral ground for clean cut-outs. Lighting: even soft studio light on source photos; the collage has paper-edge shadows only. Material: cut paper photographs with white scissor edges, tape, geometric flat paper shapes. Colour, locked to the palette {palette_words}, and nothing outside it. Texture and finish: paper grain, slight print dots, scissors-cut edges. Avoid: no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no perfect clean cut-out with no white edge, no 3D render, no blur, no gradients, no full-frame photo, no readable text.
codex.camera: flat studio scan of each cut-out; source photos shot with an 85 mm portrait lens on a neutral ground for clean cut-outs
codex.lighting: even soft studio light on source photos; the collage has paper-edge shadows only
codex.material: cut paper photographs with white scissor edges, tape, geometric flat paper shapes
codex.colour_rule: Name the palette's colours in words (the palette's `words`), never hex codes; add 'and nothing outside this palette'. Pick one palette per film and keep it.
codex.texture: paper grain, slight print dots, scissors-cut edges
negatives: no perfect clean cut-out with no white edge

aspect.note: Plates: ask for about 12% bleed around the frame so the camera can travel; keep the calm side empty for type. Generate 16:9 for the frame, 1:1 for sprite sheets and objects.

consistency.anchor: Make the anchor plate first, approve it by eye, then pass it as --ref to every other image (imagegen batch does this with --world).
consistency.style_line: Append the world bible's style line (30-45 words, no hex) to every prompt.
consistency.seed_words: Keep these words verbatim in every prompt of the film: cut paper photographs with white scissor edges; flat studio scan of each cut-out; source photos shot with an 85 mm portrait lens on a neutral ground for clean cut-outs; aged magazine paper, black, cut red, cobalt.

sprite_sheet.rules: Not a sprite style. For a cut-out object or character use --transparent (flat #00FF00 key, then despill); one subject, no shadow plane.

do: Surreal substitution with one idea: object replaces part, scale break
Keep photos tonally similar (all b/w or all warm)
Add geometric colour cuts to unify

Soft digital drop shadows instead of paper edges
